reasoning: 驗證 TLM 收到 $IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP3.SVC_Guidelines$ 時，更新 Surround View Camera Gridlines 之顯示。關鍵情境為 IPC 回報後之畫面更新，本條驗兩個值（Off／On）之顯示，為同一機制之不同輸入，依 §8.2.2 不拆。該訊號 v3 解得（BO_1294／VAL_ 0 = Off、1 = On），label 逐字取 DBC。TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info 為未解得(止於段1)，依 R-P355(c) 該步寫 PENDING，不得以 Set X.Info 假裝可執行。

tcs.tc_title: SVC Gridlines display follows the IPC reported value
pre_conditions: The named UI element "Surround View Camera (SVC) Gridlines" setting screen is displayed
test_procedure: Read the named UI element "Surround View Camera (SVC) Gridlines" control and check that it is "Off"
Read the named UI element "Surround View Camera (SVC) Gridlines" control and check that it is "On"
expected_result: The signal $IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP3.SVC_Guidelines$ = 0 (Off) is registered without a bus error
The named UI element "Surround View Camera (SVC) Gridlines" control is "Off"
The signal $IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP3.SVC_Guidelines$ = 1 (On) is registered without a bus error
The named UI element "Surround View Camera (SVC) Gridlines" control is "On"
tcs.test_item:
The HMI layer shall evaluate the received IPC_VEHICLE_SETUP3.SVC_Guidelines signal, update the TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info` internal signal, and display the **Surround View Camera Gridlines** setting information accordingly within <TDisplay>
(Reported SVC gridlines value drives the displayed control in both states)

distinguishing_axis.delta: 由 IPC 回報之 SVC_Guidelines 驅動顯示，與 -066／-067 之 HMI 送出方向相反

tcs.remarks: UI element names are taken from the setting wording named in the spec section and in the 037 description (R-VL21(a)); they are not anchored in HMI Settings List. TLM_Vehicle_Setup_Menu.Info is unresolved at stage 1 in signal_chain_v42_v3.tsv; observation method requested under DR-VL4
